channel.title: RISC-V Distros — Boards · qemu
channel.description: Which RISC-V distribution runs on which board, where to get images, and the pitfalls to expect.

item.title: Boards — QEMU virt (virtual machine)
item.description: Pure virtual platform: up to 512 RV64GC cores, CLINT/PLIC, a PCIe host bridge, 8 virtio-mmio devices, NS16550 UART, optional AIA/IOMMU; memory, disks and networking are all virtualised through command-line options, with no real GPU/VPU/NPU.
item.category: None (generic QEMU virtual platform, RV32/RV64 configurable, up to 512 cores)
